title: Config with ?? Fallbacks
hints: `??` supplies a fallback when an optional is `nil`, and it chains.
Use `Optional.flatMap` to turn a `String?` into an `Int?` without ending up with `Int??`.
jsBridge: `Int(args["port"] ?? "") ?? Int(env["PORT"] ?? "") ?? 8080` mixes optional dictionary lookups, failable parsing and fallbacks, like `Number(args.port) || Number(env.PORT) || 8080` but without the `NaN`/`0` traps.

compass.q: `Number(undefined) || 8080` works by accident because NaN is falsy. What goes wrong with port `0`?
`flatMap(Int.init)` vs `Int(x ?? "")`: which avoids parsing an empty string?
What's the type of `args["port"].flatMap(Int.init)`? Why not `Int??`?
App configuration in iOS: Info.plist, xcconfig, remote config. Which has precedence in your app?
